enonce_intro_markdown:
**SECTION D: COMPOSITION**

Choose ONE of the following topics and write a composition of about 250-300 words.

questions.enonce_markdown:
There is a lack of recreational facilities in your community and youths are getting bored with their daily routines. As their leader, you decide to raise funds in order to construct a leisure centre. Write a speech to be presented on the occasion of the fund-raising ceremony. In your speech, you may:

- Say why a leisure centre is important to the youths of your community.
- Specify the various activities that will take place at the leisure centre.
- Promise to make good use of the money to be received as well as the leisure centre itself.

Your name is Nande and your village is Bafounda.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un discours formel (*formal speech*) s'adresse à un public réuni pour une occasion précise. Il s'ouvre par une formule d'adresse au public, développe les points annoncés dans la consigne dans un ordre logique, et se termine par un remerciement ou un appel à l'action. Le registre reste soutenu (« ladies and gentlemen », pas de contractions à l'oral formel type « gonna »).

**Structure attendue :** formule d'adresse au public -> présentation de soi et de l'objet du discours -> pourquoi le projet est nécessaire -> ce que le projet apportera concrètement -> engagement/promesse -> appel à la générosité -> remerciement final. Le sujet impose trois points précis (importance du centre, activités prévues, promesse d'usage des fonds) : chacun doit apparaître clairement, dans cet ordre ou un ordre proche.

**Modèle de rédaction (anglais), environ 300 mots :**

Ladies and gentlemen, dear friends of Bafounda,

Good afternoon, and thank you all for gathering here today for this fund-raising ceremony. My name is Nande, and as the leader of the youths of our village, I stand before you with a project that is close to my heart: the construction of a leisure centre for the young people of Bafounda.

For years now, our youths have had almost nowhere to go after school or on weekends. With no recreational facilities in our community, many of them spend their free time doing nothing productive, and some are even drifting towards bad habits out of sheer boredom. A leisure centre would give them a safe, welcoming place to grow, to learn and to have fun.

Once built, this centre will offer a wide range of activities: a football pitch and a volleyball court for sport, a small library and computer room for those who wish to study or learn new skills, and a hall for music, dance and cultural events. It will be a place where talents are discovered and friendships are built.

I want to promise you all, in front of everyone gathered here, that every single franc raised today will be used transparently and exclusively for this project. A committee of respected elders will supervise the accounts, and regular reports will be shared with the community. Once the centre is completed, it will belong to all of us, and it will be maintained with the same care and honesty that guide us today.

I therefore appeal to your generosity. Whatever you can give, big or small, will bring us one step closer to giving our youths the future they deserve.

Thank you very much for your kind attention.

### Piège à éviter
N'oublie pas la consigne d'identité donnée dans le sujet (« Your name is Nande and your village is Bafounda ») : le correcteur vérifie que ces informations sont réellement intégrées au discours, pas seulement recopiées en tête de copie.

### Conseil
Dans un discours, adresse-toi directement au public avec des formules comme « ladies and gentlemen », « dear friends » ou « my fellow villagers » : c'est ce marqueur d'oralité qui distingue un discours d'un simple essai, et les correcteurs y sont particulièrement attentifs.

questions.enonce_markdown:
Imagine you are a health expert in your community. A student comes to you to get information about a health problem or a disease. Write an essay in which you discuss the following:

- Identify the disease and its symptoms.
- The causes.
- The different means of transmission.
- The prevention measures.
- Give some pieces of advice on how to treat this health problem or disease.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Quand un sujet impose une liste de points à traiter (définition/symptômes, causes, transmission, prévention, conseils), la rédaction doit suivre cet ordre en un paragraphe distinct par point : c'est une rédaction guidée, pas une dissertation argumentative avec thèse/antithèse. Chaque paragraphe reste factuel et informatif, avec un vocabulaire de santé précis.

**Structure attendue :** courte introduction identifiant la maladie -> symptômes -> causes -> modes de transmission -> mesures de prévention -> conseils de traitement. Chaque point du sujet devient un paragraphe séparé, dans l'ordre indiqué.

**Modèle de rédaction (anglais), environ 300 mots :**

Good morning. Since you came to me for information about a common health problem, I would like to talk to you about malaria.

Malaria is an infectious disease caused by a parasite called Plasmodium. Its main symptoms include high fever, chills, severe headache, muscle pain, fatigue and, in serious cases, vomiting. If left untreated, it can lead to severe anaemia or even death, especially in young children and pregnant women.

The disease is caused by the Plasmodium parasite, which lives inside a particular type of mosquito, the female Anopheles mosquito. Poor sanitation, stagnant water near homes, and a warm, humid climate all favour the breeding of these mosquitoes and therefore increase the risk of infection.

Malaria is transmitted from person to person through the bite of an infected female Anopheles mosquito. When the mosquito bites an infected person and then bites a healthy person, it passes the parasite into the healthy person's bloodstream. Malaria is not passed directly from one person to another through ordinary contact.

To prevent malaria, you should sleep under an insecticide-treated mosquito net every night, clear stagnant water around your compound, use mosquito repellents, and keep your surroundings clean. Pregnant women and young children should also take the preventive treatment recommended at the health centre.

Finally, if you notice any of the symptoms I have mentioned, do not try to treat yourself with random medicine. Go to the nearest health centre immediately for a blood test, and follow strictly the treatment prescribed by the doctor. Early treatment is the best way to avoid complications.

### Piège à éviter
Ne mélange pas les causes (le parasite Plasmodium) et le mode de transmission (la piqûre du moustique) : ce sont deux points distincts demandés séparément par le sujet, et les confondre fait perdre des points sur deux critères à la fois.

### Conseil
Choisis une maladie que tu connais bien et pour laquelle tu maîtrises un vocabulaire précis (malaria, typhoid fever, cholera...) plutôt qu'une maladie compliquée que tu risques de mal décrire : la clarté du vocabulaire médical compte davantage que l'originalité du sujet choisi.

Chaque paragraphe reste factuel et informatif, avec un vocabulaire de santé précis.

questions.enonce_markdown: Farmers of your village are facing difficulties in carrying out their activities on a daily basis. The seasons keep on changing. The rainy season during which planting is done is getting shorter and shorter, leaving the soil as dry as during the dry season. Write an article entitled "Climate Change Challenges" in the local farmers' magazine in your village to sensitise them on the causes, the consequences of these changes in seasons, and advise them on what to do to reduce the effects of the present situation. Your name is Nname.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un article de presse ou de magazine s'ouvre par un titre (déjà donné ici) et une accroche qui situe le problème, développe les causes et conséquences dans le corps du texte, et se termine par des conseils ou une ouverture. Le ton reste informatif et engageant, destiné à sensibiliser un lectorat précis - ici les fermiers du village.

**Structure attendue :** titre (fourni par le sujet : « Climate Change Challenges ») -> accroche qui situe le problème observé -> causes -> conséquences pour les fermiers -> conseils pratiques pour réduire les effets -> signature (nom donné dans le sujet : Nname).

**Modèle de rédaction (anglais), environ 300 mots :**

**Climate Change Challenges**

Dear fellow farmers, for many years now, all of us have noticed that the weather no longer follows the pattern our parents and grandparents knew. I am writing this article to explain why this is happening and what we can do about it.

The rainy season, during which we usually do our planting, is becoming shorter and shorter every year, leaving the soil as dry as it is in the dry season. This is a direct effect of climate change, caused mainly by the excessive cutting down of trees around our village, the burning of bushes before farming, and, more generally, the pollution produced by industries and vehicles around the world, which slowly warms up our planet.

The consequences of these changes are already visible in our fields. Crops that need steady rainfall, such as maize and cassava, are producing smaller and smaller harvests. Some farmers have even lost entire plantations because the rains stopped too early. If nothing is done, our village risks facing serious food shortages in the coming years.

However, we are not powerless. First, we should plant more trees around our farms and along the riverbanks, since trees help to attract rainfall and protect the soil. Second, we should adopt farming methods adapted to shorter rains, such as quick-maturing crop varieties and irrigation from wells or streams during dry spells. Third, we should avoid burning bushes and instead compost dead leaves to enrich the soil naturally.

Climate change is a real and pressing challenge for our village, but by acting together now, we can protect our farms and secure the harvests of the years to come.

Nname

### Piège à éviter
Ne transforme pas cet article en simple discours ou lettre : un article s'adresse à un lectorat large (les fermiers qui liront le magazine), pas à un interlocuteur unique - évite donc les formules comme « Dear Sir » typiques de la lettre formelle.

### Conseil
Recopie le titre exact donné par le sujet (« Climate Change Challenges ») en tête de ta copie, en gras ou souligné : un article sans titre visible perd des points au barème de présentation.
